usage: __main__.py [-h]
                   {serve,service,project,bootstrap-repo,unbind-repo,first-run,inspect,explore,doctor,verify,index-health,index-rebuild,review-queue,review-workflow,task-brief,activation-receipt,lifecycle-hook,mint-verification-receipt,signal-repair,db-health,backup,verify-backup,restore,wal-checkpoint,signal-cleanup,consolidate-runs}
                   ...

Agent Memory Bridge CLI

positional arguments:
  {serve,service,project,bootstrap-repo,unbind-repo,first-run,inspect,explore,doctor,verify,index-health,index-rebuild,review-queue,review-workflow,task-brief,activation-receipt,lifecycle-hook,mint-verification-receipt,signal-repair,db-health,backup,verify-backup,restore,wal-checkpoint,signal-cleanup,consolidate-runs}
    serve               Start the MCP server (stdio by default).
    service             Run reflex and consolidation service loop.
    project             Orchestrate project learning over existing bootstrap
                        and Explore commands.
    bootstrap-repo      Derive a bounded, commit-bound repository knowledge
                        snapshot without changing memory.
    unbind-repo         Remove one explicit local repository binding without
                        deleting snapshots or memory.
    first-run           Guide a read-only durable-memory loop without changing
                        stored memory.
    inspect             Explain governed task-memory selections and relevant
                        exclusions without changing memory.
    explore             Explore a bounded read-only projection of known
                        project relationships.
    doctor              Run non-invasive onboarding checks.
    verify              Run isolated stdio or read-only remote HTTP checks.
    index-health        Inspect derived FTS and embedding index health.
    index-rebuild       Rebuild derived indexes without changing memory rows.
    review-queue        Render a read-only operator review queue for staged
                        and dispositioned memory records.
    review-workflow     Render a proposal-only human workflow plan from the
                        operator review queue.
    task-brief          Render a read-only Task Brief from task memory, review
                        queue, and active signals.
    activation-receipt  Render a read-only cross-client activation receipt for
                        a correlation id.
    lifecycle-hook      Evaluate one optional lifecycle event from stdin.
    mint-verification-receipt
                        Mint one bounded human/operator governed-run
                        verification receipt.
    signal-repair       Explicitly reset one malformed claimed Signal to
                        pending with an audit receipt.
    db-health           Inspect SQLite integrity, foreign keys, persisted
                        JSON/vector state, and capacity metrics.
    backup              Create a consistent SQLite backup using the backup
                        API.
    verify-backup       Verify a backup without restoring it.
    restore             Restore a verified backup to the configured database
                        path.
    wal-checkpoint      Run an explicit SQLite WAL checkpoint.
    signal-cleanup      Preview or apply retention cleanup for old
                        acknowledged and expired Signals.
    consolidate-runs    Read completed run evidence and emit shadow-only
                        lesson candidates.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
